shared_elements: upright monolithic stone block as the carved support
shallow low-relief carving on a curved/flat stone surface
curved/horizontal band crossing the body of the stone
suggestion of an anthropomorphic or animate body (head-like top over a broader body)
justification: Both are tall weathered stone monoliths bearing shallow relief in which round disc/ring motifs sit on the upper body above a curving band that girdles the lower part, and both read loosely as body-like verticals with a distinct top zone. The decisive difference is that A is a flat rectangular slab covered in crisp, legible figural imagery (quadrupeds, birds, a patterned register), while B is a fully three-dimensional rounded figure whose few abstract marks are subordinate to its sculpted mass, so the manner of carving and the content are largely unrelated.
